name: phile-transfer-protocol
description: PTP connects a local FTP client to a PHP file API over HTTPS. The Node bridge runs on your own machine; the website only needs the PHP endpoint. There is no FTP daemon to install on the hosting account.

scripts.docs:build: npm run release:build && vitepress build docs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:php
scripts.test: npm run test:php-runtime && node scripts/test.cjs && node scripts/test-encrypted-transport.cjs && npm run test:wordpress
scripts.build: npm --prefix ptp-client run build && npm run build:wordpress:styles && node scripts/php.cjs ptp-wordpress/build.php
scripts.dev:server: node scripts/php.cjs --cwd ptp-server -- bin/cross-env.php PTP_ROOT_PATH=playground PTP_USERNAME=test PTP_PASSWORD=test @php -S 127.0.0.1:8000 -t src
scripts.docker:dev: docker compose --env-file ptp-server/.env.docker -f ptp-server/compose.yaml -f ptp-server/compose.dev.yaml up -d --build --wait
scripts.docker:wordpress:up: node scripts/php.cjs ptp-wordpress/build.php && docker compose -f tests/wordpress/compose.yaml up -d --wait wordpress
scripts.test:encrypted: npm --prefix ptp-client run build && node scripts/test-encrypted-transport.cjs
